messages:
Nia (mktg ops): Heads-up — building Friday KPI slides and I found a weird divergence: launch-post traffic up 40% but demo signups flat. Anyone else seeing a source-level mismatch?
Caleb (analytics): Yep saw it. Dashboard and benchmark sheet disagree. Dashboard uses SFDC demo events, benchmark sheet uses HubSpot form completions.
Rina (growth): That'll do it. We should surface both counts in the KPI snapshot so leadership isn't confused by different baselines.
Omar (demand): Also noticed webinar cohort behaves differently: higher session time but lower immediate demo click. Time-to-convert looks longer.
Nia (mktg ops): ops-bot: "ops-bot: ETL finished (2026-05-02-14:00Z)"
Caleb (analytics): Quick SQL I ran: ```SELECT source, count(distinct user_id) as users, sum(is_demo) as demos FROM events WHERE event_date BETWEEN '2026-04-20' AND '2026-04-26' GROUP BY 1```  — which pulls SFDC-ingested demos. HubSpot shows ~12% more completions for same interval.
Rina (growth): Hypothesis: HubSpot has soft conversions (form opt-in) that didn’t push to SFDC due to webhook lag. We had a partial failure last month.
Omar (demand): Could be creative mismatch too — the launch post CTA points to features, pricing page emphasizes integrations. Users expect product examples and bounce.
Nia (mktg ops): For Friday KPI slide I'd like: side-by-side HubSpot vs SFDC numbers, a cohort time-to-convert plot (7/14/30d), and a small note on creative variants.
Caleb (analytics): I'll add a toggle for attribution window and include sample size column. Also add an annotation for the webhook gap on 2026-04-22.
Rina (growth): I'll pull session replays for the webinar and launch-post cohorts to see UX expectations. If messaging mismatch, suggest a rapid A/B swap on the pricing CTA targeted to the launch-post traffic.
Omar (demand): I'll prepare two CTA variants and a short creative brief. If SFDC undercounts, we'll still detect relative CTR lift.
Nia (mktg ops): Timelines: Caleb — viz updates EOD; Omar — CTA drafts by tomorrow morning; Rina — session clips uploaded by noon. Add all outputs to the KPI deck.
ops-bot: "ops-bot: Weekly KPI sync Friday 10:00am — invite in #marketing"
Caleb (analytics): One more ask: include first-touch vs last-touch columns so we can show how attribution windows move the headline CR.
Rina (growth): Good call. That will make the bench vs live discrepancy clear.
Nia (mktg ops): Great — we'll present both raw counts and normalized CRs so leadership sees the nuance. Thanks team, ping here if anything blocks. :raised_hands:
